text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — Bluehaven Labs customer story + webinar assets. Interview scheduled Wed 11am PT. Need: final pull-quote for website, a 20s webinar clip (single sentence), 10s demo b-roll, and the transcript. Can legal do same-day review if we post candidate copy?
Priya: I’ll run the interview and capture a clean 20s take. I can also grab a short B-roll of the UI.
AssetBot: Recording placeholder created: https://drive.redwood/bluehaven/session_3745.mp4
Theo (sales): For lead routing, we want a 2-field form (email + company size) and webhook into SFDC campaign "Bluehaven - Webinar". Can I get a 1-line quote by 1pm so SDRs have copy?
Rae (legal): Reminder: any numeric claims (%, ms) require written permission from the customer. If they provide numbers live, please get an email confirmation or a signed release. Otherwise we publish a non-numeric fallback e.g. "meaningful reduction in per-request cost."
Emi (product): Small wording note: prefer the phrase `continuous batching` in customer-facing lines instead of just `batching`. Also avoid internal metric names unless the customer is comfortable.
Maya: Raw candidate quote from Bluehaven (paraphrased): "Redwood cut our per-token costs by ~37% and halved p99 latency." Posting for legal review.
Rae (legal): Change `~37%` -> `meaningful` or attach sign-off. Also need a signed media release for the recorded clip if we put the customer on the webinar slide. I’ll ping the Bluehaven legal contact now.
Theo (sales): If we have to redact numbers, I’ll use this for the slide: "Bluehaven saw meaningful cost reductions and faster latency." That’s SDR-ready.
Priya: I’ll record both versions live (numeric + cleaned) and add timecode markers for the 20s export. Will upload master + clips by 4pm PT.
Maya: Timeline recap: Wed 11am interview -> Priya uploads assets by 4pm -> Rae to approve quote/public language or request redaction by EOD -> Theo builds Typeform + webhook and preps SDR messaging.
Emi (product): Also flag: if we put a short technical blurb in the case writeup, use this sentence: "Bluehaven reduced per-request compute with continuous batching and KV-cache optimizations." Use only if Bluehaven confirms accuracy.
Rae (legal): Got it. I’ll follow up with Bluehaven counsel; will post permission status here.
AssetBot: Reminder set: follow up with legal in 3 hours. :bell:
Maya: Thanks team. Ping in thread if anything blocks — we need one approved sentence for the webinar slide by 1pm. :rocket:
